name: Kothalipi v0.1.8
body:
## What's New in Kothalipi v0.1.8

- **Engine Priority & Fallback Controls:** Choose Cloud API First (Gemini/OpenAI/Groq → Local fallback) or Local Model First (Offline → Cloud fallback), toggle Local Offline Model On/Off independently, toggle Automatic Backup Fallback On/Off, and see the live priority chain.
- **Free Groq Whisper Provider:** Added Groq (`whisper-large-v3-turbo`) as a super-fast, free-tier cloud speech-to-text provider with a one-click Get Key link.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Kothalipi/kothalipi-desktop/compare/v0.1.7...v0.1.8
